name: io.github.ShaanGS/ventriloquist
title: Ventriloquist
description: Turn Mac apps into MCP tools via the accessibility API: no screenshots, no model per step.

environmentVariables.name: VENT_ALLOW_HIGH
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to run tools a pack marks as high risk without asking. Without it, they're offered only to clients that can ask you to confirm each call (MCP elicitation).

environmentVariables.name: VENT_HEAL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let the server call a model to re-ground broken anchors. Off keeps serving model-free.

environmentVariables.name: VENT_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory for your own packs and traces. Defaults to ~/.ventriloquist.

environmentVariables.name: VENT_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to serve read-only tools only. Every other call is refused, even with VENT_ALLOW_HIGH.

environmentVariables.name: VENT_NO_VALUES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1, together with VENT_HEAL=1, to keep field values out of what the healer sends to the model.
